description: Verify that the file 'label.png' exists in the project root and is a valid PNG image.
criteria: File exists and has a valid PNG header (89 50 4E 47).

description: Ensure the image dimensions match the specified measured pouch plate size.
criteria: Width and height must exactly match the required plate dimensions (e.g., 300x200 pixels or as defined in project config).

description: Validate that the label contains legible text suitable for OCR extraction.
criteria: Running an OCR engine on the image must return a non-empty string containing the expected label identifier or product name.

description: Confirm the image is in a prepress-ready color mode and resolution.
criteria: Image must be in RGB or CMYK mode (not indexed/palette) and have a DPI of at least 300.

description: Verify that the label includes a scannable barcode or QR code for readiness verification.
criteria: A barcode detection library must successfully locate and decode at least one barcode/QR code within the image.
